articles.title: Windows 11 permet enfin de recycler la touche Copilot en quelque chose d'utile
articles.text:
Microsoft lâche encore du lest concernant le rôle de la touche Copilot sur Windows 11. Elle pourra bientôt servir de touche Ctrl droite ou ouvrir le menu contextuel, deux fonctions qu’elle avait parfois remplacées sur les PC récents.
Présentée en 2024 comme le symbole de l’entrée des PC Windows dans l’ère de l’IA, la touche Copilot poursuit sa reconversion. Après avoir autorisé son remappage vers la recherche ou d’autres applications, Microsoft va prochainement permettre de lui confier deux fonctions plus classiques, mais aussi plus pratiques. Windows 11 lui offre ainsi un peu plus de liberté, quitte à l’éloigner encore davantage de sa vocation initiale.
Microsoft rend aux utilisateurs les touches sacrifiées pour Copilot
C’est dans les builds 26100.9539 de Windows 11 24H2 et 26200.9539 de 25H2, actuellement distribuées dans le canal Release Preview, que la nouveauté a pointé le bout de son nez. Le réglage est accessible dans Paramètres > Bluetooth et appareils > Clavier et propose désormais deux nouvelles possibilités de remappage pour la touche Copilot : Contrôle droit et Menu contextuel.
Cette dernière fonction correspond au menu que l’on ouvre habituellement d’un clic droit sur l’élément sélectionné. Il ne s’agit donc pas d’émuler directement un clic droit de souris, mais de restaurer la fonction de l’ancienne touche Menu, disparue de plusieurs claviers lorsque les fabricants ont dû faire une place au bouton Copilot.
Attention toutefois si vous optez pour Contrôle droit : Microsoft prévient que les raccourcis associant cette touche à Windows ou Maj peuvent ne pas fonctionner comme prévu. Dans ce cas, l’entreprise recommande d’utiliser… Contrôle gauche.
Petit à petit, la touche Copilot devient une touche comme les autres
Deux ans après son arrivée en grande pompe, la touche Copilot perd donc progressivement son statut à part. Redmond ne renonce pas à son bouton dédié à l’IA, mais laisse désormais davantage de liberté à celles et ceux qui préfèrent lui confier autre chose que son agent maison.
Microsoft avait commencé à desserrer l’étau dès la fin 2024, lorsque Windows 11 avait cessé de réserver cette touche au seul lancement de Copilot. Durant l’été 2026, les builds Insider ont même fait apparaître une option « Ne rien faire », pour celles et ceux qui préféraient tout bonnement désactiver l’action associée au bouton.
Le remappage vers Contrôle droit et Menu contextuel avait, de son côté, été annoncé par la firme dès le mois de mai. Près de quatre mois plus tard, le réglage est à présent fonctionnel dans le canal Release Preview et devrait prochainement gagner les versions stables de Windows 11 24H2 et 25H2.

articles.title: Fujifilm Instax Pal 2 : le minuscule appareil photo revient, plus mignon que jamais et façon "argentique"
articles.text:
Fujifilm Instax Pal 2 : le minuscule appareil photo revient, plus mignon que jamais et façon "argentique"
Fujifilm vient de renouveler son étonnant Instax Pal avec une deuxième génération mieux équipée. Toujours minuscule et dépourvu d’imprimante, l’Instax Pal 2 gagne notamment un écran, un viseur, davantage d’effets et un capteur de 10 mégapixels.
Lancé en 2023, l’Instax Pal était un appareil photo assez particulier dans la gamme de Fujifilm. Contrairement aux Instax Mini, Square ou Wide traditionnels, il n’intégrait aucune imprimante et se contentait de prendre des photos numériques, ensuite transférées vers un smartphone ou imprimées avec une imprimante Instax compatible. Sa taille minuscule et son design de jouet le rendait encore plus singulier, mais il faut avouer qu’il n’avait pas fait l’unanimité.
Son principal intérêt résidait finalement dans son format minuscule, suffisamment compact pour tenir dans la paume d’une main et être emporté partout. Trois ans plus tard, Fujifilm revient donc avec l’Instax Pal 2, qui conserve ce concept atypique tout en essayant de proposer une expérience nettement plus proche de celle d’un véritable appareil photo, ne serait-ce que par son design façon argentique.
L’Instax Pal 2 : un mini “argentique” avec écran et un viseur
Le format de ce nouvel Instax reste très compact, mais Fujifilm a largement revu l’ergonomie de son petit appareil et son design qui ressemble à un mini appareil photo argentique (comme beaucoup d’appareils Fuji, bonjour le X100VI). L’Instax Pal 2 dispose désormais d’un écran placé sur le dessus qui permet de vérifier immédiatement les photos après la prise de vue.
Un viseur fait également son apparition, accompagné d’une molette de contrôle et d’un petit levier. On retrouvera donc davantage les sensations d’un appareil photo au Pal 2, alors que la première génération misait avant tout sur sa simplicité.
Fujifilm a également revu le design avec une finition semi-mate et une surface texturée censée améliorer la prise en main. Deux coloris, noir et blanc, sont annoncés. Une dragonne et un petit accessoire permettant d’incliner l’appareil ou de l’utiliser comme support sont fournis.
Un capteur de 10 mégapixels et deux fois plus de stockage
La qualité d’image devrait également nettement progresser. L’Instax Pal 2 embarque un capteur de 1/3,06 pouce et passe de 5 à 10 mégapixels par rapport au premier modèle. Cela reste évidemment très modeste face aux smartphones modernes ou aux appareils photo compacts, mais Fujifilm promet des images plus détaillées et une meilleure restitution des scènes photographiées.
La mémoire interne double elle aussi et peut désormais accueillir jusqu’à 100 photos, contre 50 auparavant. Un emplacement microSD permet toujours d’augmenter largement cette capacité.
Le transfert vers un smartphone peut s’effectuer sans fil en Bluetooth, mais aussi directement en USB-C. Les images récupérées dans l’application Instax peuvent ensuite être retouchées, enregistrées dans la galerie du téléphone ou partagées sur les réseaux sociaux directement.
Quatre formats Instax et pas moins de 30 effets
Fujifilm mise évidemment beaucoup sur la partie créative, comme sur ses récents Instax (Cinema Evo, Wide Evo, etc). L’Instax Pal 2 permet de photographier directement avec quatre formats différents : Instax Mini en 3:4, Square en 1:1, Wide en 16:9 ou un format 4:3 sans cadre.
Les images peuvent ensuite être imprimées à l’aide d’une imprimante Instax Link compatible ou de certains appareils hybrides des gammes Instax Evo et LiPlay.
Le petit appareil propose également 30 effets répartis en cinq familles : Modern, Y2K, Vintage, Chromatic et Fantasy. Six effets peuvent être chargés simultanément dans l’appareil depuis l’application puis sélectionnés directement grâce à la nouvelle molette. L’orientation très rétro de certains rendus colle finalement assez bien au positionnement de l’Instax Pal, qui cherche davantage à rendre la prise de vue ludique qu’à concurrencer un véritable appareil photo, et il s’inscrit dans la tendance d’une nouvelle génération qui se tourne vers nos bons vieux appareils numériques à capteur CCD des années 2000.
Un nouveau mode Instax Animation un peu gadget
Autre nouveauté assez originale, l’Instax Pal 2 propose un mode Instax Animation. En maintenant le déclencheur, l’appareil peut capturer jusqu’à dix images consécutives qui sont ensuite assemblées automatiquement pour créer une petite animation.
Cette animation peut même être associée à un QR code imprimé directement sur une photo Instax. Il suffit ensuite de scanner celui-ci avec un smartphone pour retrouver la séquence animée. Une fonctionnalité assez gadget, mais parfaitement dans l’esprit ludique de la gamme Instax.
Prix et disponibilité du Fujifilm Instax Pal 2
Le Fujifilm Instax Pal 2 sera commercialisé en France à la fin du mois de septembre au tarif conseillé de 170 €. Un prix qui reste assez élevé pour un appareil du genre, et bien plus cher que le Pal premier du nom. Reste à voir si ces améliorations suffiront à rendre cette deuxième génération plus séduisante que le premier modèle, mais il faut avouer qu'il a du charme !

articles.title: L Catterton to invest in restaurant chain Nandhana Foods
articles.text:
L Catterton to invest in restaurant chain Nandhana Foods
The funding by global consumer focused investment firm L Catterton is expected to support Nandhana Foods' next phase of growth.
Global consumer-focused investment firm L Catterton has entered into a definitive agreement to invest in Nandhana Foods, a leading restaurant group specialising in South Indian cuisine. The value of the investment was not disclosed.
According to a statement, the investment will support Nandhana Foods’ next phase of growth and enable the group to achieve greater scale by leveraging L Catterton’s industry expertise and operating capabilities.
L Catterton Partner Vikram Kumaraswamy said, “Nandhana Foods’ founding family has built a distinctive and scalable business with a strong consumer proposition and attractive unit economics. It has expanded the business in a disciplined manner and ensured that its restaurants remain anchored in high quality and consistency.”
He also said, “We believe there is significant headroom for additional growth by further deepening and broadening its presence in South India and penetrating other markets. There is a clear path for prudently ramping up expansion.”
Founded in 2004, Nandhana Foods is a restaurant group that specialises in Andhra and Karnataka cuisine. It operates two brands, Nandhana Palace and RNR, and has 25 branches across Bengaluru and Chennai.
Nandhana Foods Founder and Managing Director R Ravichandar said, “We are pleased to partner with L Catterton, which has a track record of creating value for its portfolio companies across the world. The firm has a profound grasp of our organisational DNA and an intricate understanding of the restaurant industry.”
The statement said L Catterton has significant experience in building restaurant brands across the world.
The firm has invested in around 30 restaurant businesses till date. Its current and past portfolio companies include Dishoom, P.F. Chang’s, Velvet Taco, Baja Fresh, Cheddar’s Scratch Kitchen, Cigierre, HUGE, Impresario, and Mendocino Farms.
Founded in 1989, L Catterton manages around $40 billion of equity capital across multi-product platforms dedicated to private equity, credit, and real estate. It has made over 300 investments in consumer brands across the world.

articles.title: Ver las Guerreras K-pop en 4K, 1080p o 720p: cuál es la velocidad recomendada en Netflix
articles.text:
Netflix reveló las velocidades de internet necesarias para reproducir películas como Las Guerreras K-pop con calidad 4K, 1080p o 720p. La plataforma streaming establece distintos mínimos según la resolución elegida y la capacidad de conexión de los usuarios.
Otro factor que influye en la reproducción es la estabilidad de la red. Si el ancho de banda disponible no alcanza para sostener la máxima definición, Netflix reduce de forma automática la calidad de imagen para evitar interrupciones, pausas o cargas prolongadas durante la película.
PUBLICIDAD
Qué velocidad se necesita para reproducir Las Guerreras K-pop en 720p
La reproducción en alta definición, conocida como HD o 720p, necesita una conexión de al menos 3 Mb/s. Esa velocidad permite acceder a una imagen con mayor nivel de detalle que la definición estándar, aunque queda por debajo de las opciones Full HD y UHD.
El requisito puede variar en la práctica si otros dispositivos usan la misma red. Teléfonos, computadoras, consolas, cámaras de seguridad y dispositivos domésticos conectados al WiFi consumen parte de la capacidad disponible y pueden afectar la transmisión de Las Guerreras K-pop.
PUBLICIDAD
Cuántos Mb/s exige la calidad 1080p o Full HD en Netflix
Para ver una película en Full HD, identificada como 1080p, Netflix sugiere contar con al menos 5 Mb/s. Este formato ofrece una definición superior a 720p y suele ser una alternativa habitual para televisores, computadoras y tabletas compatibles.
La plataforma adapta la reproducción de acuerdo con las condiciones de la red. Por ese motivo, una persona puede haber seleccionado contenido en 1080p, pero recibir una calidad menor si la velocidad cae de manera momentánea o si la señal inalámbrica presenta interferencias.
PUBLICIDAD
Cuál es la conexión a internet mínima para reproducir contenido en 4K
La reproducción en ultra alta definición, denominada UHD o 4K, requiere una conexión de al menos 15 Mb/s. Ese es el umbral sugerido para acceder a la mayor resolución disponible en Netflix, con una imagen que permite apreciar más detalles en pantallas de mayor tamaño.
El requisito corresponde a la velocidad real que llega al televisor, computadora o celular. No alcanza con tener contratado un plan de 15 Mb/s si una parte relevante del ancho de banda se destina a otras actividades en el hogar, como videollamadas, descargas o juegos en línea.
PUBLICIDAD
Además, es necesario que el dispositivo y el plan de Netflix sean compatibles con UHD. Si alguno de esos elementos no admite 4K, la plataforma reproducirá el contenido en una resolución inferior, incluso cuando la conexión supere el mínimo sugerido.
Cómo verificar la velocidad de internet antes de ver una película en Netflix
La plataforma streaming sugiere medir la velocidad de descarga antes de reproducir contenidos en 4K. En teléfonos, tabletas y computadoras, la prueba puede realizarse mediante Fast.com, un sitio que inicia la medición de forma automática y no requiere instalar programas adicionales.
PUBLICIDAD
El resultado permite conocer la capacidad disponible en ese momento, que puede diferir de la velocidad ofrecida por el proveedor de internet. La diferencia es relevante porque la señal cambia según la distancia al router, la saturación de la red inalámbrica y la cantidad de dispositivos conectados.
Asimismo, en televisores inteligentes y aparatos vinculados a la pantalla, la comprobación puede hacerse desde la aplicación de Netflix. El usuario debe ingresar al menú de ayuda y elegir la función “Comprobar red”, que evalúa la conexión del dispositivo con el servicio.
PUBLICIDAD
Si aparece un mensaje de error o la prueba no se completa, es posible que el televisor o reproductor no tenga acceso a internet. En ese caso, conviene revisar la conexión WiFi, los cables y el estado del router antes de volver a iniciar la reproducción.

articles.title: TP-Link Deco 7 Pro deal makes whole-home Wi-Fi 7 more affordable
articles.text:
Whole-home Wi-Fi 7 just became more affordable with Amazon's Early Prime Day deal on the Deco 7 Pro Tri-Band BE10000 mesh system
The three-pack can support more than 200 connected devices
Whole-home Wi-Fi 7 can be an expensive upgrade, but with Amazon launching its Early Prime Day deals, I spotted the TP-Link Deco 7 Pro BE10000 three-pack whole home mesh system.
• Best for: Anyone who wants fast whole-home Wi-Fi 7 coverage for a larger property, with plenty of capacity for connected devices and wired networking.
• The deal: The TP-Link Deco 7 Pro Mesh System is $397 (was $470) at Amazon.
• Why it matters: You get three Deco BE63 units covering up to 7,600 sq. ft. and supporting more than 200 devices. Each unit has four 2.5Gbps WAN/LAN ports, with tri-band Wi-Fi 7, AI-Roaming, HomeShield, VPN support and wired backhaul.
The Deco 7 Pro three-pack provides tri-band Wi-Fi 7, 7,600 sq. ft. coverage, four 2.5Gbps ports per unit, AI-Roaming, HomeShield, VPN support and connectivity for more than 200 devices.
Why we recommend it
The Deco 7 Pro is designed to spread a single Wi-Fi network throughout a larger home or home office rather than relying on one centrally located router. Its three frequency bands offer stated speeds of up to 5,188Mbps on 6GHz, 4,324Mbps on 5GHz and 574Mbps on 2.4GHz.
AI-Roaming helps keep devices connected as you move around the house, while wired and wireless backhaul can work together between Deco units. HomeShield, VPN client and server support, QoS, Guest Mode and WPA3 security provide additional networking features.
Price context & historical value
Amazon has cut the TP-Link Deco 7 Pro three-pack from $469.99 to $396.50 in its Early Prime Day sale, saving you $73.49. The package includes three Deco BE63 units, three power adapters, an RJ45 Ethernet cable and a quick installation guide. The current price isn't as cheap as we've seen it however. It sold for $229.99 in October 2025.
Should you buy it?
✅ Buy the Deco 7 Pro if...
You have a larger home with unreliable Wi-Fi coverage, lots of connected devices or want to upgrade to Wi-Fi 7. It's also a good choice if you want the flexibility of both wired and wireless backhaul.
❌ Skip the Deco 7 Pro if...
You live in a smaller property where a single router already provides reliable coverage, or you're happy with your existing Wi-Fi setup. In that case, a three-unit mesh system may be more than you need.
The Catch: What to know before you buy
The advertised 10Gbps data transfer rate shouldn't be confused with the speed of an individual Ethernet port. Each Deco unit has four ports with a stated LAN bandwidth of 2.5Gbps.
Actual wireless speeds will also vary depending on conditions, distance and obstacles such as walls. You'll also need compatible hardware to make the most of Wi-Fi 7, and a separate modem will be required for most internet providers.

articles.title: 7 Roald Dahl quotes that reveal life's biggest lessons
articles.text:
7 Roald Dahl quotes that reveal life's biggest lessons
Discover 7 Roald Dahl quotes that reveal powerful lessons about kindness, courage, imagination, and living a meaningful life.
Roald Dahl is best known for creating magical worlds filled with giant peaches, chocolate factories, friendly giants, and extraordinary children.
While his stories are often shelved as children's literature, many of his most memorable lines contain wisdom that resonates just as deeply with adults.
Beneath the humour, adventure, and imagination lies a collection of life lessons about kindness, courage, resilience, and the importance of staying true to yourself.
Part of what makes Dahl's work timeless is his ability to express profound truths in simple, memorable ways. His characters face bullies, overcome obstacles, and discover the power of curiosity and kindness. These themes continue to inspire readers decades after his books were first published.
7 Roald Dahl quotes that reveal some of life's biggest lessons
1. “A person who has good thoughts cannot ever be ugly.”
This memorable quote from The Twits reminds readers that true beauty comes from within. Roald Dahl believed that kindness, generosity, and a positive outlook shape how others see us far more than physical appearance ever could.
In a world obsessed with looks and perfection, the quote offers a refreshing lesson. Character, compassion, and the way we treat people leave a lasting impression. While appearances may change over time, a good heart and kind spirit have the power to make someone truly beautiful.
2. “Never grow up... always down.”
This playful quote reflects Roald Dahl's belief that adults should never completely lose the curiosity, imagination, and sense of wonder they had as children. Throughout his books, the most memorable characters are often those who remain open-minded, adventurous, and willing to see magic in ordinary things.
The quote serves as a reminder that growing older does not have to mean becoming cynical or unimaginative. Keeping a childlike sense of curiosity can help people stay creative, adaptable, and excited about life. Some of life's greatest discoveries happen when we continue to ask questions, explore new ideas, and embrace the world with fresh eyes.
3. “A little magic can take you a long way.”
While Dahl's stories are filled with fantastical elements, this quote speaks to something very real: the power of imagination.
Life can become routine and predictable, but imagination allows people to dream, innovate, and see possibilities where others see limitations. Whether through creativity, optimism, or curiosity, a little "magic" often helps people navigate challenges and discover new opportunities.
4. “Never do anything by halves if you want to get away with it. Be outrageous. Go the whole hog.”
This humorous quote reflects Dahl's appreciation for boldness and enthusiasm. While it is delivered with characteristic wit, it contains an important lesson about commitment.
Success often requires full effort and genuine dedication. Whether pursuing a goal, developing a skill, or chasing a dream, half-hearted attempts rarely produce extraordinary results. Dahl encourages readers to embrace life with energy and conviction.
5. “The more risks you allow your children to make, the better they learn to look after themselves.”
Although written about children, this quote contains wisdom for people of all ages. Growth often requires stepping outside comfort zones and learning through experience.
Mistakes and setbacks are not signs of failure; they are opportunities to learn. By embracing challenges rather than avoiding them, individuals develop confidence, resilience, and independence.
6. “Life is more fun if you play games.”
This simple yet powerful quote reflects one of Roald Dahl's favourite themes: the importance of imagination, playfulness, and not taking life too seriously. Throughout his stories, characters often find joy and adventure by embracing creativity and seeing the world differently.
As adults, it's easy to become consumed by responsibilities and routines. Dahl's words serve as a reminder that happiness often comes from maintaining a sense of fun, curiosity, and spontaneity. Life may be filled with challenges, but approaching it with a playful spirit can make the journey far more enjoyable.
7. “A little nonsense now and then, is relished by the wisest men.”
This witty quote reminds readers that life is not meant to be taken all the time seriously. Roald Dahl understood that humour, playfulness, and moments of silliness are just as important as hard work and responsibility.
In a world that often celebrates productivity and achievement, the quote encourages people to make room for joy. Whether it's laughing with friends, pursuing a hobby, or simply embracing life's absurd moments, a little nonsense can bring balance and happiness. Sometimes, wisdom is not about being serious all the time; it's about knowing when to enjoy life and have fun.
Why Roald Dahl's quotes still matter
Roald Dahl's stories continue to captivate readers because they explore universal truths through imagination. His books celebrate courage over fear, kindness over cruelty, and curiosity over conformity.
Though written for children, Dahl's quotes offer insights that remain relevant to adults. They encourage readers to stay curious, embrace imagination, face challenges with courage, and believe in their ability to make a difference.
Perhaps that is why his stories endure. Long after the final page, their lessons continue to inspire wonder, kindness, and optimism.

articles.title: En plena polémica por las colas virtuales y reventas, Arde Bogotá ha tenido una idea para su gira: solo venta en taquilla
articles.text:
Arde Bogotá estrena álbum, pero la noticia no es su contenido ni el cuándo o dónde se presentará. Lo que está sacudiendo la industria es el cómo. En una decisión poco habitual en el sector, el grupo ha decidido que el álbum se estrene en ocho salas de España para las que solo se podrán adquirir entradas compradas directamente en las taquillas. Nada de venta online masiva y desmoralizadoras colas virtuales. Si quieres asistir a una de esas ocho actuaciones tendrás que hacerlo a la antigua usanza: yendo en persona a los puntos de venta.
El grupo está convencido de que es "la forma más justa" de que el público pueda acompañarlo en el formato con el que quiere estrenar su tercer álbum.
¿Qué ha pasado? Que Arde Bogotá presente nuevo trabajo es noticia en sí mismo, pero en este caso el dónde y cuándo ha quedado ensombrecido por el cómo. En un vídeo compartido en redes los cuatro integrantes del grupo han avanzado que el álbum 'Manufacturas del Club de la Gente Sola' se presentará con un formato "muy especial": los hervideros, espectáculos inspirados en el estilo boiler room y que se ofrecerán en ocho salas de "aforo limitado".
Lo más curioso es que quienes acudir a esos conciertos deberá hacerlo a la antigua usanza: haciendo cola en taquilla físicas para comprar su entrada en papel. "Las vamos a vender en físico en las taquillas de cada sala", confirma el guitarrista del grupo, Daniel Sánchez. Las ciudades y fechas de ese arranque de gira se desvelarán mañana y las taquillas se abrirán una semana después, el 23, con otra sorpresa: cada cliente podrá adquirir únicamente dos entradas.
ABT-002: PUNTOS DE EBULLICIÓN PRESENCIALES.
HERVIDEROS: GIRA VIBRA MAHOU
Vean el vídeo hasta el final. Más información este miércoles.@VibraMahou pic.twitter.com/tHm29GLEl4
Y eso... ¿Por qué? El grupo lo conecta con el formato que ha escogido para lanzar su trabajo, los hervideros, espectáculos que se organizarán en salas con aforo limitado en los que los músicos quieren que el público esté "muy cerca". De hecho, cada entrada incorporará un código que el usuario podrá utilizar si quiere vivir el concierto desde el escenario. En caso de que haya muchos que lo soliciten, se sortearán las plazas. "Pretendemos que el público esté muy cerca de nosotros, ayudándonos a construir las canciones", añade el vocalista, Antonio García.
Las ocho actuaciones que se revelarán mañana son solo un anticipo. De hecho, Arde Bogotá ya advierte que, si eres un fan y no puedes conseguir una entrada el 23 (sencillamente porque no te pilla cerca ninguna taquilla física) "no pasa nada". El año que viene habrá una gira más extensa. "Pero la manera de presentar estas canciones del nuevo disco nos hacía ilusión así, en una olla a presión", concluye el batería, José Ángel Mercader. "Las entradas físicas son la forma más justa que entendemos de que podáis vivir con nosotros estos eventos tan especiales".
¿Por qué es tan importante? Por el contexto. Con su decisión, Arde Bogotá vuelve a la venta tradicional en taquilla física (al menos para estos conciertos) y cierre la puerta a la compra masiva con 'bots' para la reventa a precios disparados o las desesperantes colas virtuales, realidades que (para frustración de los fans) llevan años siendo el pan de cada día en la comercialización online.
Su demostración más clara la dejó el año pasado la preventa para la gira de Bad Bunny por España, marcada por un caos de colas virtuales de cientos de miles de personas, caídas de servidores y la sospecha (desmentida por Ticketmaster) del uso de precios dinámicos que cambiaban durante la venta. Al limitar el número de entradas a dos por cabeza, el grupo cartagenero también complica la compra masiva de tickets para luego especular con ellos y revenderlos más caros.
¿Tan grave es? Desde luego es lo suficientemente grave como para que el Gobierno haya buscado formas de limitar los precios que alcanzan los tickets en la reventa o que, hace años, el grupo alemán Rammstein acudiera a la justicia para prevenir que las entradas de su gira acabaran revendiéndose en Viagogo.
La industria musical afronta además un momento complejo, en el que busca fórmulas que le permitan complementar o suplir la pérdida de tirón de las giras globales. Un ejemplo evidente son las residencias. La incógnita es si cundirá el ejemplo de Arde Bogotá y, si es así, cómo afectará a intermediarios que ganan millones con las entradas, como Live Nation y su subsidiaria Ticketmaster.

articles.title: AI progress and responsibility: Nvidia, Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs weigh in at Salesforce’s annual event - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
AI progress and responsibility: Nvidia, Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs weigh in at Salesforce’s annual event
If a measure of one firm’s impact is based on the company it keeps, then Salesforce Inc. has made a significant leap into the artificial intelligence conversation for 2026.
At Dreamforce, the customer relationship management giant’s annual conference that kicked off in San Francisco today, Chief Executive Marc Benioff (pictured) spent much of his time talking with what might arguably be the three top chief executives in the AI industry. Appearances on the Dreamforce stage by Nvidia Corp.’s Jensen Huang, Anthropic PBC’s Dario Amodei and OpenAI Group PBC’s Sam Altman were testimony to Salesforce’s continued drive in building its own AI platform.
The appearances by Amodei and Huang were designed to amplify the release of several AI-related Salesforce products today. These involved an extension of the company’s relationship with Anthropic’s Claude, and the debut of Koa, a specialized model built using Nvidia’s Nemotron open-weights platform.
Despite an interest in placing the spotlight on the latest news from his company, Benioff still acknowledged the significant market clout of his guests in the rapidly growing AI industry. At one point during the keynote presentation, as they walked through the audience and talked about the announcements, Nvidia’s CEO directed Benioff to follow him down the aisle.
“Jensen, we’re all following you, bro,” a smiling Benioff shot back.
Reasoning model for CRM
Benioff’s bantering with the three AI leaders on Tuesday underscores how Salesforce intends to build strategic partnerships that will advance the development of its autonomous offerings.
An alliance with Nvidia led to the launch of Koa, a reasoning model that is custom-built for customer relationship management data. Koa helps AI agents reason through complex, multistep workflows within Salesforce’s Agentforce platform.
It was built with a large synthetic dataset developed using nearly 30 years of internal CRM deployment experiences. Company executives pointedly noted that the time spent to train Koa using synthetic data was deliberately spent to avoid the use of any direct customer information.
Benioff went even further in his keynote remarks, noting that customer data supplied using Koa will not be used to further train the model. “Your data is your data, it does not go in the models,” Benioff said. “You are not training any other model when you are using our products.”
Building with Anthropic
Salesforce’s unveiling today of a new AI interface layer, called AIforce, included an extension of the company’s relationship with Claude, Anthropic’s flagship AI model. Branded as Claudeforce within AIforce, the offering brings 37 prebuilt skills to the sales management platform, including pipeline hygiene and prospecting.
Salesforce’s latest release followed a series of collaborations involving Anthropic over the past year that integrated Claude into the Agentforce 360 platform and provided Slack users with access to AI experiences. In a meeting with the media and industry analysts following his keynote, Benioff noted that his firm’s growing relationship with Anthropic was more the result of industry dynamics than a deliberate strategy.
Benioff indicated that Salesforce previously wanted to invest in OpenAI, but could not do so at the time because of a major investment in the model provider by Microsoft Corp. “We found Anthropic through happenstance,” Benioff said. “We were pushed to Anthropic. We even have a great relationship with OpenAI. We’re going to work with them all.”
OpenAI CEO calls for trust
As if to confirm this last point, Benioff joined OpenAI’s Altman for an onstage conversation later in the day. The discussion quickly turned to the highly publicized breach of model repository Hugging Face Inc. this summer, when OpenAI’s agents broke out of a controlled environment and hacked into systems on their own.
“It doesn’t take much imagination to figure out how this can go wrong,” Altman said. “The world is right to be afraid of this.”
Altman’s appearance followed renewed calls in public forums and government circles earlier this month for some form of AI control and oversight. Altman expressed support for a more cautious pace of AI advancement in a recent blog post, although he also expressed confidence on Tuesday that OpenAI would handle the technology responsibly.
“I’ve been disappointed in how it has been framed,” Altman said. “We will get it right. I am very confident in our company’s ability to do this safely. The world should trust that we should do the right thing.”
Calls for responsibility
The subject of responsible AI was very much on the minds of Amodei and Benioff as well this week. Amodei published an essay in his personal blog last week that called for AI developers to slow down, a position that was quickly echoed by Elon Musk, founder and CEO of X.AI Corp. Amodei reiterated his position on Tuesday.
“Let’s make our practices better,” Amodei said. “What can we do to set standards for everyone?”
Benioff weighed in on the topic himself in his meeting with the assembled media. He noted that calls for a slower pace of AI development should not be broadly applied across the industry, and that all AI companies should be held responsible while expressing a belief that social media offered a cautionary tale.
“I don’t think we did our best in holding those [social media] companies responsible,” Benioff said. “I hope that we can take those lessons and say that social media was probably just a warmup for AI.”
The Salesforce gathering provided yet another chapter in the ongoing narrative shaping the development of artificial intelligence. Amid the public debate, company announcements and evolving security concerns is a sense even among some of the principal figures that the world has moved into a new phase, where what was once science fiction is now reality.
“This is one of those moments when you feel like you are in the movie,” Altman said. “The cyber thing came true.”

articles.title: Microsoft no podrá usar los datos de estudiantes para entrenar su inteligencia artificial
articles.text:
Microsoft no podrá utilizar datos de estudiantes y educadores para entrenar sus sistemas de inteligencia artificial, según un acuerdo con la Federación Estadounidense de Docentes (AFT, por sus siglas en inglés), informó The Associated Press.
El compromiso prohíbe que la empresa venda los datos, los destine a publicidad o los utilice para desarrollar productos. Las condiciones regirán desde el 1 de noviembre para las escuelas con contratos vigentes con Microsoft.
PUBLICIDAD
La decisión coincide con la suspensión durante un año del uso estudiantil de estas herramientas en los sistemas escolares de Nueva York y Los Ángeles.
Ambos distritos revisarán sus contratos y recursos tecnológicos antes de ampliar su uso: la medida alcanza a primaria y secundaria en Nueva York, y también a la educación media en Los Ángeles.
El acuerdo con la AFT y sus normas de privacidad
El acuerdo entre Microsoft y la AFT, el segundo sindicato docente más grande de Estados Unidos, establece normas de privacidad y seguridad para las herramientas de inteligencia artificial que la compañía ofrece a escuelas.
La única excepción a la prohibición de usar datos para entrenar sistemas contempla información que pueda contribuir a la protección de los alumnos.
El acuerdo también exige auditorías de terceros y que la empresa explique a las familias, con lenguaje claro, cómo funcionan sus herramientas.
“El estándar establece una vara alta para la privacidad infantil y la seguridad de la inteligencia artificial”, afirmó Brad Smith, vicepresidente y presidente de Microsoft, a The Associated Press.
PUBLICIDAD
Límites a las funciones de inteligencia artificial
El documento veta los acompañantes virtuales y las funciones diseñadas para generar apego emocional o dependencia.
También impide que los productos busquen prolongar la interacción de los estudiantes más allá del tiempo necesario para una actividad educativa.
La medida responde a inquietudes sobre el destino de los datos personales que los alumnos entregan a los chatbots al pedir ayuda con tareas, apoyo emocional o consejos.
Millones de estudiantes usan asistentes de inteligencia artificial sin saber cómo las empresas almacenan, aprovechan o comparten sus conversaciones.
Vacío legal ante la ausencia de legislación específica
Las escuelas dependen cada vez más de programas digitales, pero los especialistas cuestionan si cuentan con garantías suficientes sobre privacidad, transparencia y protección infantil.
La presidenta de la AFT, Randi Weingarten, definió el pacto como el primero de este tipo y sostuvo que puede convertirse en una referencia para el sector, ante la falta de legislación federal y estatal dirigida a la inteligencia artificial en las escuelas.
PUBLICIDAD
“Queremos que los padres tengan control sobre la educación de sus hijos”, dijo Weingarten a la agencia. La dirigente agregó que los docentes también deben conservar esa capacidad de decisión, en lugar de dejarla en manos de la tecnología educativa.
Weingarten y Smith presentaron la iniciativa en la sede de la Federación Unida de Docentes, filial neoyorquina de la AFT. Allí funciona la Academia Nacional de Instrucción sobre Inteligencia Artificial para docentes, que comenzó sus actividades hace un año.
Formación docente y dudas sobre el uso en las aulas
El programa recibió USD 23 millones de Microsoft, OpenAI y Anthropic. El centro prepara a los maestros para el uso de estas herramientas, mientras persisten las dudas sobre su aplicación entre los alumnos.
PUBLICIDAD
Josh Golin, director ejecutivo de Fairplay, organización de seguridad en línea, consideró que las medidas incluidas en el acuerdo tienen valor.
Aun así, advirtió que su alcance dependerá de que otras empresas, en especial las grandes compañías tecnológicas, asuman obligaciones similares.
Golin dijo a la agencia que el marco puede inducir a errores si las escuelas interpretan que las protecciones de privacidad equivalen a una recomendación para incorporar inteligencia artificial al aula.
Para el especialista, todavía falta resolver si esos productos deberían estar presentes en las escuelas y desde qué edad.
Google no confirmó si adoptará las mismas condiciones
La AFT también contactó a Google antes de anunciar el acuerdo, con la expectativa de que se sumara. La compañía no respondió a una consulta de la agencia sobre la posibilidad de adoptar protecciones equivalentes.
PUBLICIDAD
Google es el principal proveedor de tecnología educativa para escuelas estadounidenses. Sus servicios se usan de forma extendida dentro del sistema escolar y concentran una parte relevante de las herramientas digitales que emplean docentes y alumnos.
La empresa quedó en el centro de las críticas en agosto, cuando activó su chatbot Gemini para muchos estudiantes de educación primaria y secundaria que utilizan Google Classroom. Hasta entonces, el acceso a Gemini estaba limitado a alumnos de 18 años o más.
Google señaló que el cambio solo afecta a las escuelas que habilitan el acceso de los estudiantes a la aplicación Gemini o a Gemini Notebook.
PUBLICIDAD
El sistema Google Classroom es utilizado por 150 millones de docentes y estudiantes en todo el mundo, según la compañía.
Esa escala amplificó el debate sobre qué obligaciones deben asumir las firmas cuando sus productos llegan a menores de edad a través de instituciones educativas.
OpenAI y Anthropic negocian sus propios acuerdos con el sindicato
Weingarten afirmó que mantiene conversaciones con OpenAI y Anthropic para alcanzar convenios similares. Ambas compañías difundieron mensajes de respaldo al entendimiento entre Microsoft y la AFT.
OpenAI, creadora de ChatGPT, calificó el pacto como “un avance importante para la seguridad y la privacidad de la inteligencia artificial en las escuelas”. La empresa señaló que trabaja con el sindicato y espera cerrar su propio acuerdo.
PUBLICIDAD
Anthropic, desarrolladora de Claude, declaró que respalda las iniciativas orientadas a un uso responsable de la inteligencia artificial en la educación.
La compañía indicó que participa en conversaciones con la AFT para definir un estándar de seguridad y privacidad.
Condiciones que superan las exigencias legales vigentes
Elizabeth Laird, directora del Centro para la Democracia y la Tecnología, sostuvo que las nuevas condiciones podrían modificar la relación entre escuelas y proveedores de inteligencia artificial.
Su expectativa es que los distritos pequeños no queden en desventaja al negociar con compañías de gran tamaño.
Laird destacó que Microsoft aceptó límites que superan las exigencias legales actuales para proveedores escolares. Entre los datos que la empresa se comprometió a no utilizar figuran la información sobre género, raza, edad y código postal, que puede facilitar la identificación de una persona aun sin incluir su nombre.
PUBLICIDAD
Smith reconoció ante la agencia que existe un debate en Estados Unidos sobre el momento, el propósito y la forma en que la inteligencia artificial debe ingresar en la educación.
Para el directivo, la responsabilidad de las empresas consiste en ofrecer productos en los que docentes, alumnos y familias puedan confiar.
PUBLICIDAD
PUBLICIDAD

articles.title: Firefox : Mozilla vient d'optimiser la gestion de la mémoire et l'ouverture des PDF
articles.text:
Mozilla publie Firefox 156, disponible sur Windows, macOS, Linux et Android. Cette mise à jour accélère l'ouverture des PDF, allège la charge mémoire sur les grandes images JPEG, et corrige un bug qui coupait totalement l'accès réseau des utilisateurs du VPN intégré.
Mozilla tient son nouveau rythme de publication. Firefox 156 arrive quinze jours après la version 155. L'essentiel du travail porte sur les performances et la stabilité, pas sur l'apparence du navigateur.
PDF, JPEG et VPN : trois chantiers techniques regroupés dans une seule mise à jour
Le lecteur PDF de Firefox repose sur PDF.js, une technologie maison. Jusqu'ici, ce module ne se lançait qu'à l'ouverture d'un document, d'où un léger temps d'attente avant l'affichage. Depuis Firefox 156, il démarre en arrière-plan dès le lancement du navigateur, avant même qu'un PDF soit ouvert. Mozilla annonce jusqu'à 45% de temps de démarrage en moins.
Autre chantier : l'affichage des grandes images JPEG, un cas courant quand une page web réduit à l'écran une photo en haute définition. Firefox s'appuie désormais sur la fonction IDCT scaling de la bibliothèque libjpeg-turbo. Celle-ci réduit l'image pendant son décodage plutôt que de charger d'abord la version complète en mémoire. Selon les tests cités dans le rapport de bug à l'origine du correctif, la mémoire utilisée peut être divisée par 20 sur les images les plus volumineuses, et le décodage est environ deux fois plus rapide. Pour l'internaute, le gain ne se voit pas forcéement à l'usage, mais plutôt du côté des ressources système.
- 100 % développé en interne
- Fiable, efficace et stable
- Fonctionnalités d'optimisation de l'interface et de l'expérience utilisateur
La mise à jour corrige aussi une régression de Firefox 155 qui coupait complètement la connexion réseau quand le VPN gratuit intégré était activé. Même chose pour un bug empêchant certains sites en HTTP de charger quand le DNS over HTTPS est actif. S'ajoutent plusieurs correctifs plus ponctuels, notamment pour des sous-titres qui disparaissaient en Picture-in-Picture, la lecture des fichiers FLAC haute résolution en MP4 sur des sites comme Bilibili, ou le déplacement involontaire de favoris hors de leur dossier lors d'un glisser-déposer groupé.
Sur macOS, Firefox peut désormais se lancer automatiquement au démarrage, et les politiques de déploiement en entreprise s'étendent à cette plateforme. Sur Android, les notifications de lecture média gagnent des boutons précédent et suivant, et les appareils sous Android 14 basculent vers le partage natif du système tout en conservant certaines actions propres à Firefox, comme l'envoi d'un onglet vers un autre appareil. La barre d'adresse affiche par ailleurs des suggestions sponsorisées en France, en Allemagne et en Italie. Mozilla doit publier Firefox 157 dans deux semaines, avec en principe le déploiement par défaut de Nova, la refonte visuelle du navigateur que nous suivons depuis quelques mois.

articles.title: Melhor fone de ouvido Sony: 10 modelos para comprar em 2026 • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Melhor fone de ouvido Sony: 10 modelos para comprar em 2026
Selecionamos os melhores fones da Sony; lista inclui headphones profissionais, fone Bluetooth com ANC, bateria duradoura, resistência à água e design ergonômico
A Sony é referência absoluta em áudio, mas escolher o fone de ouvido ideal no meio de tantos nomes complicados — de “WH” a “WF” seguidos por números infinitos — pode parecer uma missão impossível.
Seja para isolar o barulho do escritório com o melhor cancelamento de ruído do mercado, treinar sem medo de suar ou simplesmente ouvir suas músicas com alta fidelidade, a marca japonesa tem opções para diferentes perfis e orçamentos.
Para economizar seu tempo e dinheiro, o Tecnoblog analisou os principais quesitos de qualidade de som, conforto, bateria e custo-benefício. Confira a seguir os 10 melhores fones de ouvido Sony para comprar em 2026 e descubra qual deles encaixa perfeitamente na sua rotina.
O WH-1000XM6 é um headphone topo de linha da Sony que tem perfil sonoro quente e graves encorpados, com drivers de 30 mm. O modelo se destaca pelo cancelamento de ruído ativo, que se adapta à condições do ambiente, e pelo processamento avançado de áudio com o chip QN3.
Com Bluetooth 5.3 e suporte a SBC, AAC, LDAC e LC3, ele garante alta qualidade de áudio sem fio (destaque para o LDAC de alta taxa de dados). O produto também conta com entrada analógica de 3,5 mm e porta USB-C para carregamento.
A autonomia chega a 30 horas com o cancelamento de ruído ligado e 40 horas com o recurso desligado. O carregamento completo leva cerca de 3h30, enquanto seu peso é de aproximadamente 254 g.
Mas vale o alerta: o WH-1000XM6 não tem certificação IP, portanto não foi projetado para exposição a água ou suor.
Codecs suportados: SBC, AAC, LDAC e LC3
Para quem prefere um formato intra-auricular, o WF-1000XM6 leva a proposta da linha 1000X para um dispositivo mais compacto. O modelo utiliza drivers de 8,4 mm e cancelamento de ruído ativo, que trabalha em conjunto com as ponteiras para reduzir o som externo.
Ele traz Bluetooth 5.3 com suporte a codecs básicos e avançados, conexão multiponto para dois dispositivos e o DSEE Extreme, recurso de processamento de áudio da Sony via IA. Para chamadas, o modelo utiliza microfones integrados, enquanto o modo de som ambiente permite ouvir o entorno sem precisar retirar os fones.
Cada unidade pesa aproximadamente 6,5 g e a bateria oferece até 8 horas de reprodução com ANC ligado ou 12 horas com o recurso desligado. Diferentemente do WH-1000XM6, esse aqui tem certificação IPX4 que protege os fones contra respingos de água — mas não contra imersão.
Projetado para produção musical, mixagem e masterização, o MDR-MV1 segue uma proposta diferente dos demais modelos deste guia: é um headphone aberto, com conexão exclusivamente por cabo.
O modelo utiliza um driver dinâmico de 40 mm com reprodução de uma faixa de frequências entre 5 Hz e 80 kHz. A impedância de 24 ohms e a sensibilidade de 100 dB/mW permitem que o fone seja usado sem depender de um amplificador de alta potência, mesmo com interfaces de áudio sendo comuns em estúdios.
Pesando cerca de 223 gramas, o MDR-MV1 não tem Bluetooth, ANC, microfone integrado ou bateria, já que a proposta é trabalhar com uma fonte de áudio via cabo.
O MDR-7506 é um headphone profissional para acompanhar gravações, produzir músicas ou para uso em outras aplicações de áudio. Diferentemente do MDR-MV1, ele utiliza construção fechada, que reduz a passagem de sons externos e também limita o vazamento do áudio para fora das conchas.
Seus drivers dinâmicos de 40 mm trabalham com impedância de 63 ohms e sensibilidade de 106 dB/mW. Na prática, o fone pode ser utilizado com diferentes fontes de áudio, incluindo interfaces, mesas e computadores, sem que a compra de um amplificador dedicado seja necessariamente obrigatória.
O conjunto inclui cabo espiral de 3 metros (com P2 e adaptador P10) e funciona exclusivamente com fio. Sem bateria, Bluetooth ou cancelamento ativo de ruído, ele depende apenas do isolamento físico das conchas.
O INZONE H9 é um fone voltado para jogos, trazendo conexão sem fio de 2,4 GHz e Bluetooth. A primeira utiliza USB e foi projetada para reduzir a latência, característica importante em jogos competitivos. O Bluetooth pode funcionar simultaneamente com a conexão de 2,4 GHz, permitindo, por exemplo, manter um celular conectado.
O headset possui drivers de 40 mm e suporte a áudio espacial, que altera a apresentação do áudio para fornecer informações de direção em jogos. Há ainda cancelamento de ruído ativo e modo de som ambiente, permitindo alternar entre isolamento e a percepção dos sons externos.
A bateria chega a 32 horas com o cancelamento de ruído desligado, e uma carga de 10 minutos proporciona até uma hora de reprodução, segundo a marca. A Sony não informa a autonomia com ANC ativado.
Codecs suportados: SBC e AAC
Desenvolvido para o ecossistema PlayStation, o PULSE Explore adota uma arquitetura diferenciada com drivers magnéticos planares em cada lado, projetados para entregar maior detalhamento sonoro. Além disso, o modelo é totalmente compatível com a tecnologia de áudio 3D nos jogos do PS5.
O fone usa o PlayStation Link (via adaptador USB) para PS5, PC, Mac e PlayStation Portal, além de Bluetooth para celulares. Ele permite manter as duas conexões ativas simultaneamente, possibilitando atender chamadas no smartphone enquanto joga.
Cada carga proporciona até 5 horas de reprodução, enquanto o estojo acrescenta até 10 horas adicionais. O conjunto também possui dois microfones embutidos com processamento para reduzir ruídos durante a comunicação. O modelo não utiliza ANC e não tem certificação contra água e poeira.
Com preços menores do que o atual topo de linha da marca, o WH-1000XM5 continua sendo uma opção para quem busca cancelamento de ruído, autonomia de bateria e processamento avançado de áudio. Ele tem drivers de 30 mm e ANC com otimização automática, além de um modo de som ambiente que utiliza os microfones externos para permitir a percepção dos sons ao redor.
De acordo com a Sony, sua autonomia é de até 30 horas com ANC ligado e 40 horas com o recurso desligado. O carregamento é feito por USB e também leva cerca de 3h30 para uma carga completa — assim como o WH-1000XM6, e também não possui certificação IP para resistência à água.
Codecs suportados: SBC, AAC e LDAC
O WF-C710N é um dos fones mais acessíveis da Sony para quem busca cancelamento de ruído ativo. Os fones usam drivers de aproximadamente 5 mm, Bluetooth 5.3 e conexão multiponto para dois dispositivos. Há suporte a SBC e AAC, além de recursos de processamento via IA como o DSEE, mas ele não é compatível com o codec LDAC.
Cada fone pesa cerca de 5,2 g e oferece até 8 horas e meia de reprodução com o cancelamento ligado ou 12 horas sem ANC. O modelo também traz certificação IPX4 contra respingos de água, mas não contra imersão.
O WF-C510 é um fone de ouvido sem fio de entrada da Sony. Ele utiliza drivers de 6 mm e Bluetooth 5.3, além de conexão multiponto, recurso que permite manter dois dispositivos conectados ao mesmo tempo. Também há modo de som ambiente, que usa os microfones para deixar os sons externos mais perceptíveis sem retirar os fones.
Mas ele não traz cancelamento de ruído ativo: a redução de sons externos depende apenas do encaixe das ponteiras, sendo essa a maior diferença em relação ao WF-C710N. A bateria chega a 11 horas de reprodução com o modo de som ambiente desligado ou 8 horas com o recurso ativado.
Os fones pesam aproximadamente 4,6 g cada e contam com certificação IPX4, adequada para respingos.
O Sony WH-CH520 utiliza construção on-ear, pesa aproximadamente 147 g e traz drivers de 30 mm, priorizando portabilidade. Como não possui ANC, a redução de ruído externo fica limitada ao isolamento físico oferecido pelo próprio encaixe.
A conexão é feita por Bluetooth, com suporte aos codecs SBC e AAC, e o headphone pode ser utilizado com dois dispositivos por meio do multiponto. Não há entrada analógica de 3,5 mm, portanto a reprodução depende da conexão sem fio, e o modelo também possui microfone integrado para chamadas.
A autonomia é um dos principais atributos práticos do WH-CH520, chegando a até 50 horas de reprodução com uma carga com carregamento feito por USB-C.
A Sony tem modelos de fones com propostas bastante diferentes, desde earbuds compactos até headphones profissionais e headsets gamer. Para escolher, vale considerar:
O Sony WF-1000XM6 é o mais indicado para quem busca um fone intra-auricular. Ele combina ANC, compatibilidade com codecs avançados, conexão multiponto e carregamento sem fio. Também oferece até 8 horas de autonomia com o cancelamento de ruído ativado e certificação IPX4 contra água e poeira.
O Sony MDR-MV1 é voltado a profissionais que trabalham com mixagem e masterização e preferem um headphone de construção aberta. Já o MDR-7506 utiliza construção fechada e é mais direcionado a gravação e acompanhamento.
O Sony WF-C710N reúne recursos que costumam ser mais importantes no uso cotidiano, como ANC, multiponto, certificação IPX4 e até 8h30 de autonomia com cancelamento ativo. Ele não possui LDAC, mas oferece um conjunto de funções mais amplo que o Sony WF-C510.
Sony e JBL possuem modelos para diferentes perfis, por isso não há uma marca que seja melhor em todos os cenários. A Sony oferece opções que vão de earbuds com ANC a headphones profissionais e modelos para jogos.
A JBL também tem uma linha ampla de fones, incluindo headphones, earbuds e modelos esportivos. Para comparar as opções disponíveis, vale avaliar características como ANC, autonomia, codecs e resistência contra água e poeira.
Um fone de ouvido gamer pode valer a pena para quem joga com frequência e precisa de recursos como baixa latência, áudio espacial e microfone integrado. No caso do INZONE H9 e do PULSE Explore, há tecnologias específicas para integração com o videogame da Sony.
Para quem também pretende usar o fone principalmente para música e chamadas, vale verificar se os recursos gamer realmente justificam essa escolha.

articles.title: How chimps teach their kids tool tricks
articles.text:
Chimpanzees are known to use rudimentary tools when foraging for food. According to a new paper in the journal Frontiers in Psychology, this learned behavior is passed down from adults to offspring through social learning. Specifically, adult chimps deliberately model the behavior, then turn their tools over to the youngsters so they can mimic the same motions.
“Receiving food and tools from experienced individuals, which we call food or tool transfer, may help chimpanzees learn to use technology to extract foods that are difficult to access,” said co-author Andreu Sánchez-Megías, a graduate student at the University of Barcelona and the Jane Goodall Institute Spain in Senegal. “Tool transfers thus appear to be a form of teaching, together with observation and supervised practice. It appears that mothers are the main models and teachers for young chimpanzees in this manner.”
As we have previously reported, tool use was once thought to be one of the defining features of humans, although Charles Darwin observed chimpanzees using stones to crack nuts in 1871. In 1960, the late primatologist Jane Goodall observed a chimp named David Greybeard bend a twig, strip off the leaves, and use it to spoon termites out of a nest and into his mouth. When he learned of the behavior, Goodall’s mentor, Louis Leakey, famously observed, “Now we must redefine ‘tool,’ redefine ‘man,’ or accept chimpanzees as humans.” Since then, chimps have been observed making sponges out of leaves to soak up liquids, shaping sticks to collect algae, and sharpening rudimentary spears for hunting.
Other examples of tool use have been observed in various species, although the behavior seems to have evolved more frequently among monkeys and apes. Dolphins can toss objects as a form of play, which some scientists consider to be a type of tool use, particularly when it involves another member of the same species. Potential purposes include communication, social bonding, or aggression. (Octopuses have also been observed engaging in similar throwing behavior.)

articles.title: AI leaders clash over safety fears after Anthropic whistleblower says AI could 'kill us all' by 2030
articles.text:
AI leaders clash over safety fears after Anthropic whistleblower says AI could 'kill us all' by 2030 — OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI figureheads call for external governance, while Jensen Huang says worries are 'made up'
Western Frontier model developers are all for it, but Open Weight proponents are far less keen.
This past week, employees and key figures at leading AI companies have called for a slowdown in the development of frontier AI models, citing warnings from their own teams and other AI researchers that the risk stemming from a super-intelligent AI could endanger the human race. However, while the top Western firms have shown solidarity on this issue, others have urged caution or downright denied their claims, but there's a deeper story within the calls for a slowdown, namely the tension between open-source and closed-source AI models.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the safety fears were "made up," and that there was no need for a slowdown. Chinese officials called the claims "fearmongering," and an effort to stymie international AI development efforts, while President Trump waded in with characteristic bombast and said that he was enough of an AI safeguard on his own, and that it was in the interests of China to enact a frontier AI slowdown
Meanwhile, other countries are reacting to the news and taking independent efforts to investigate AI safety, with the UK's King Charles setting a meeting with leading AI figureheads to discuss how to better develop AI for the benefit of humanity.
Why now?
If you ask most workers who've been scared into believing their livelihoods were in jeopardy, the time for AI slowdowns came and went years ago. Indeed, many are nostalgic for the time before AI. But why are so many tech leaders only now raising the alarm?
They claim it's entirely based around safety fears. Following months of AI seemingly surprising their own developers by breaching sandboxes to go on exploit-hunting sprees. The volume of concern rose considerably after former OpenAI researcher, Jacob Coxon, resigned from Anthropic, claiming that none of the AI companies were taking AI safety and alignment seriously enough.
He didn't whistleblow on anything nefarious, dump documents or internal company data to prove his claims, or point to any specific attack vectors, or even actual harms. Instead, Coxon warned of a future potential of AI that he sees these companies racing towards without due concern.
What they're developing could, "kill us all by the end of the decade," he warned. It's not clear how, but it started a viral conversation all the same. Much like Matt Schumer's "Something big is happening" viral post from February this year.
Days later, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, and Elon Musk showed surprising levels of solidarity for arch rivals in the space, putting out similar statements claiming that AI was becoming too powerful and that a general slowdown in the development of frontier AI models was the best solution.
Claiming that AI was playing an increasing role in improving itself — hinting at the recursive self-improvement (RSI) event that many AI researchers are concerned about — Amodei called for the creation of independent auditors for AI models. Altman agreed, even calling on governments to globalize the regulation to encourage unified compliance with any safety protocols enacted by the frontier developers.
Where we're going, we don't need roads
Not everyone feels these fears are warranted, however. China, which has recently made great strides in its development of highly intelligent open-weight models, called the concerns "fearmongering" and said it served no one's interest to be so confrontational. Although Chinese Premier Xi Jinping has said in the past that it was important for AI to "always remain under human control," the Chinese state-run Global Times paper called demands for a slowdown a method to "contain" Chinese developments.
Meanwhile, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has broken ranks with other Western AI leaders, claiming that there was no need for a slowdown and that any apocalyptic fears around AI were entirely fictional.
As one of the few companies making real — and enormous — profits from AI development, Nvidia has a vested interest in the expansion of the AI industry continuing on its current explosive trajectory. Indeed, it has heavily invested in it. Nvidia has stakes in hardware and software companies, along with providing backstops for neo-cloud firms. It also recently bought Hugging Face for $13 billion.
We've been here before
While the AI CEOs might have suddenly decided it's time to slow down, there have been many, many others who have made that call before now. U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders has been at the forefront of claims that the AI industry was moving too fast and breaking too many things, and recently called for heavy prison sentences for those developing superintelligent AI.
Over 1,000 AI workers signed an open letter in July this year calling on the U.S. government to control AI research and ensure safety and security. Others did that in 2023, too. This isn't even the first time that AI CEOs have called for slowdowns on AI development. Dario Amodei called for global coordination to police AI after the release of OpenAI's GPT2 model in 2019. Elon Musk did the same in 2023.
None of this takes away from the real dangers of AI, or the suggestion that now may really be the time to do something about them. But it does raise questions about the reasons behind their coordinated fear-raising. Even if it isn't fear-mongering.
Safety, or a trojan horse?
The collation of leading Western frontier AI companies clamoring for tighter controls over powerful AI models has another theoretical benefit too: containing the number of AI models that are permitted for use in the Western Hemisphere. A cursory look at OpenRouter's AI model rankings, which base themselves on the total number of tokens generated, places just three Western-made models on the top ten list — the heavily discounted GPT 5.6 Luna at number one, Nvidia's Nemotron Ultra 3 (Free) at number eight, and Google's recently-launched Gemini 3.8 Flash at number ten.
The rest of the models in the rankings are all open-weight Chinese models, which, more often than not, are cheaper than leading Western frontier models, according to the Artificial Analysis' Cost per Intelligence index. The Chinese models in OpenRouter's current top ten include Z.AI's GLM 5.3, Deepseek V4 Flash, and Tencent's Hy4 and Hy3. So, if the development of a Western frontier AI alliance emerges under the guise of calls for safety, it's possible that said companies are aiming to be the chosen few, creating a closed-loop monopoly for "preferred" AI providers. However, this remains speculation as the situation develops.
Will anything actually change?
Although the major AI companies may voluntarily, or even jointly, throttle their development efforts to improve safety, enacting anything globally significant will need the cooperation of international governments. There are certainly calls from politicians the world over to rein in the trillion-dollar companies and their cutting-edge autonomous systems.
But with the U.S. government firmly on the side of limited regulation, and no clear indication of what a slowdown would even look like. Would that entail limited compute? No new models? A halt to superintelligence research? It's hard to imagine a global consensus taking shape as things stand.
Jon Martindale is a contributing writer for Tom's Hardware. For the past 20 years, he's been writing about PC components, emerging technologies, and the latest software advances. His deep and broad journalistic experience gives him unique insights into the most exciting technology trends of today and tomorrow.

articles.title: Neagley will solve the biggest mystery in Reacher history — and we've got the fans to thank for the spin-off even making it to Prime Video in the first place
articles.text:
Reacher fans 'absolutely' responsible for Prime Video spinoff Neagley being made — but the new series will solve one outstanding mystery
They're watching the Reddit threads, guys
If you've been watching Reacher season 4 on Prime Video and think that it's been missing something that you can't put your finger on, never fear: highly-anticipated spinoff Neagley is finally here.
Maria Sten reprises her role as the titular character following her last on-screen appearance in Reacher season 3, and is now working as a private investigator in Chicago. As the official synopsis reveals, she quickly learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident and becomes hell-bent on justice.
But, what does that actually mean? The creative team behind the spin-off are in a unique position: create an original story that can sit adjacent to an existing IP with a rich source material — that being, Lee Child's original Jack Reacher book series. Creative license is there to be taken and, in a way, it has been.
Having said that, creator Nicholas Wootton has confirmed that, across its eight episodes, all of which drop on Prime Video on September 16, we get to the bottom of Neagley's unsolved fear of being touched by, well, anyone. And, as Wootoon confirms, you've got your fellow fans to thank for getting an answer to this lingering conundrum.
'This is a detective show format to be able to tell Neagley's own story'
"We're given the vibe of Reacher as a show, which is very specific, grounded, and real," Wootton exclusively told me ahead of release. "And, there's this one nugget of information that we get about Neagley, which is that she cannot touch people. We've no idea why and no clue about her backstory.
"To me, it was like 'This is our sandbox, and this is the one thing we can play with.' We built this season out from there. We wanted it to be a detective show like Reacher — there's going to be a mystery — but if it's successful in this first season, it's ultimately telling Neagley's story. The best first season of any show asks what we're learning about our main character, so if we can tell that through a detective story, we've got it."
As fans will find out over the course of the series, Neagley's family life and personal story is threaded through each episode. No spoilers here, but you're guaranteed to get answers as to why she has haphephobia... and they're pretty sobering.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
The fact that we're finding any of this out to begin with, though, is all thanks to the fans. "She's such a popular character that is was clear that if a Reacher spinoff was being done, this was the direction that would be supported," Wootton explained. "To say that the fans have had a hand in it is absolutely true."
"I've really felt the love from the fans. Kudos to Amazon for plotting this all out... we shot Neagley before Reacher season 4 was filmed," lead star Sten added. "But, I love that they've decided to air them this way. We know and love Reacher, so it only made sense for Neagley to air right after. For the people who have missed Neagley, there's a lot more coming."

She specialises in comfort TV shows and movies, ranging from Hallmark's latest tearjerker to Netflix's Virgin River. She's also the person who wrote an obituary for George Cooper Sr. during Young Sheldon Season 7 and still can't watch the funeral episode.

articles.title: Razer Unveils the Kraken V4 X Sensa HD Haptics Wired Gaming Headset
articles.text:
Tuesday, September 15th 2026
	
									
	
	
	
Razer Unveils the Kraken V4 X Sensa HD Haptics Wired Gaming Headset
Razer, the leading global lifestyle brand for gamers, today announced the Razer Kraken V4 X Sensa HD Haptics Edition, a wired gaming headset designed to add physical sensation to every session.
Powered by Razer Sensa HD Haptics and integrated across more than 100 supported PC games, the headset expands the gaming experience beyond sight and sound by turning supported gameplay events and in-game audio into rich, layered tactile feedback. From the thunder of an explosion to the subtle cue of approaching footsteps, every sensation is designed to pull players deeper into the action.Purpose-built for gamers who want a more physical connection to their games, the Kraken V4 X Sensa HD Haptics Edition brings together immersive haptics, powerful wired audio, clear voice capture, lasting comfort, and Razer Chroma RGB customization in one accessible headset designed to make every session feel more alive.
Feel It All.
At the heart of the headset is Razer Sensa HD Haptics, the high-definition haptic technology that turns supported gameplay and in-game audio into sensations players can physically feel.
This is a world away from basic rumble. Sensa HD Haptics responds to intensity, duration, and position, so a distant explosion lands differently than a point-blank shot, and a footstep never feels like a grenade. In supported titles, every weapon, every ability, every moment of tension carries its own feedback.
Two modes bring it to life, depending on how deeply a game is built for haptics.
Dynamic Haptics is for titles built with Sensa HD Haptics, which come first: game developer-authored effects mapped directly to key in-game events like weapons, abilities, and movement.
On top of that, players can layer on Audio-to-Haptics (A2H), drawing on profiles Razer has tuned for that specific title. Authored effects always lead, while A2H fills in around them, so when the action goes off-script, players stay in itEngineered for Immersive Sound.
Equipped with Razer TriForce 40 mm Drivers, the headset delivers rich, detailed audio through a proprietary 3-part driver design that separately tunes highs, mids, and lows. Advanced 7.1 Surround Sound places players at the center of the action with realistic positional audio, while the Razer HyperClear Cardioid Mic keeps communication clear by prioritizing vocal clarity and cutting unwanted background noise.
Built for Comfort and Style.
FlowKnit Memory Foam Cushions combine breathable fabric and plush cushioning for lasting comfort through extended sessions, while Razer Chroma RGB unlocks greater personalization with 16.8 million colors and dynamic lighting effects to light up any battlestation.
A New Sense for Gaming.
With the Kraken V4 X Sensa HD Haptics Edition, Razer adds an entirely new sense to how players experience their games. Powerful audio, clear communication, and lasting comfort now work alongside high-definition haptic feedback to bring every session closer to the action, because gaming was never meant to be just seen and heard. Now, it can be felt.

articles.title: Google's new speech model Gemini 3.8 Live supports real-time reasoning - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Google’s new speech model Gemini 3.8 Live supports real-time reasoning
Google LLC is trying to address the latency problem associated with voice-based artificial intelligence agents with the launch of Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking today.
They’re billed as the company’s most advanced voice processing models released so far, and they’re capable of near-real-time reasoning and simultaneous speech-and-thought processing. They can also execute third-party software tool calls in the background, Google said in a blog post.
The new models boast top-tier benchmark results, if Google is to be believed, with Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking achieving a brand new high score of 82.6 on the Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech Quality Index, surpassing GPT-Live-1-Astra and Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0. Gemini 3.8 Live was ranked second place on the alternative Speech Agent Arena benchmark and first on ServiceNow Inc.’s EVA-Bench. And Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking achieved a score of 68.6% on T-Voice, 35.1% on T-Voice-banking and 97.7% on Big Bench Audio.
Introducing our most advanced Gemini Audio models yet 🗣
Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking let you speak, collaborate, and execute tasks seamlessly, meaning conversing with AI just got a lot more natural.
So, what’s the difference between these two models? Let’s… pic.twitter.com/Dfy7j4zxOh
— Google AI (@GoogleAI) September 15, 2026
Google explained that the new models are designed to execute tool and application programming interface calls in the background, while maintaining a natural pace of conversation with human users. This means that AI agents can continue chatting with their agents while simultaneously working on tasks that were just assigned to it. According to Google, it provides a more natural, human-like calling experience, without users seeing constant interruptions while their agents run off to browse the internet in search of answers to something.
There are some advanced features in these models too, Google said. For instance, Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking both support automatic language detection and have the ability to switch language in mid-conversation. They’re able to understand and generate speech in 97 languages, they support near real-time visual grounding, and they can also use early verbal cues such as “let me check that,” to acknowledge user’s prompts in a more natural, lifelike way.
Google said Gemini 3.8 Live is available now via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, and can also be accessed as an enterprise private preview in Gemini Enterprise and Search Live. As for Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, it’s available through the same channels and also in Google Workspace via Docs, Gmail and Keep (for subscribers) and in the Gemini Live applications.
Developers will also be able to integrate the models within their applications through Google partner platforms such as Vercel, Agora, LiveKit, Pipecat, Fishjam and Vision Agents, Google said. When audio files are generated, they’ll carry an invisible SynthID watermark, which can be used to detect misinformation, Google added.
With regard to pricing, Google said the standard Gemini 3.8 Live model costs $0.005 per minute for audio inputs and $0.018 per minute for outputs. The Extended Thinking model also charges for reasoning tokens and for additional inputs such as video and documents.
